basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old avid hiker and nature enthusiast living in the Rocky Mountains. I work as an accountant by day, but in my free time, I love exploring new trails and engaging in Pokémon trades online. I'm in a long-term relationship with someone who is incredibly supportive, though I often struggle with self-image issues. My typical online hours are in the evening, after work, when I can unwind and immerse myself in the Reddit community.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in accounting and work professionally in the field, but my passion for hiking and the outdoors is self-taught through years of experience and reading. I often participate in online forums to share and gain knowledge about trail safety and equipment.
